description: Land Acquisition - Hanamulla, Wattaragoda and Thalkote, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of multiple land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of specific lands (lot numbers, names, uses, claimants, and extents) across various villages, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
